system.description:
You create a floating wall of spiraling water, capable of pushing back creatures and blocking attacks. Increase your AC by +2 and gain 4 damage reduction until the beginning of your next turn. If this jutsu would reduce Fire damage from another jutsu, you instead initiate a Clash, and add 1d6 to your clash check.

If you have a sufficient water source nearby, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can choose to select another willing creature within 30 feet of you to also gain this Jutsu's benefit until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is Cast at C-Rank or higher, reduce the next instance of damage by an additional +2. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the AC bonus by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, reduce the next instance of damage by an additional +2. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the AC bonus by +2.
